databaseProfiles: SQLite WAL, one worker, 8 concurrent upload clients

environment.VISTARA_DERIVATIVE_AUTHORIZATION: optional; public CDN runs should omit it
environment.VISTARA_RUN_UPLOADS: set true for upload concurrency with abort cleanup
environment.VISTARA_UPLOAD_RUN_ID: required with uploads; stable unique CI run identifier
environment.VISTARA_GALLERY_URL: required populated /library URL for Chromium frontend budgets
environment.VISTARA_BROWSER_AUTHORIZATION: optional bearer/API-key header for the gallery and API requests
